note: Profiles describe which checks matter for a strategy type. A profile never raises a verdict: it reports which required checks ran and what is not assessed. Not investment advice.

profiles.title: Trend following / CTA
profiles.summary: Time-series momentum on one or many instruments, long and short, usually with volatility targeting.
profiles.benchmark: Buy-and-hold of the same instrument(s); beta-neutral residual

not_assessed.why: no continuous-contract roll data is read from OHLCV; a spliced back-adjusted series hides roll cost
one history cannot show the next crisis

traps.description: A trend filter with a centred moving average reads bars after the decision.
Flipping position every bar looks active but costs eat the edge.

controls.description: Random entries on random prices: no edge exists, so no pass level may be reached.
A causal moving-average rule on random prices: not flagged for look-ahead, and no edge claimed.

profiles.title: Mean reversion
profiles.summary: Fades short-term moves back to a mean (z-score, RSI, Bollinger style) on one instrument or a basket.
profiles.benchmark: Random entry with matched holding time

not_assessed.why: a short sample rarely contains the sequence that ends the account
spreads widen when a z-score is extreme; only quotes can show it

traps.description: Z-score from the mean and deviation of the whole file uses the future.
High-turnover reversion with no cost margin.

controls.description: Random entries on random prices: no edge exists, so no pass level may be reached.
A causal moving-average rule on random prices: not flagged for look-ahead, and no edge claimed.

profiles.title: Pairs and statistical arbitrage
profiles.summary: Trades the spread of two or more related instruments, long one leg and short another.

not_assessed.why: needs a borrow history the verifier does not have; a fee and an unavailable share can be declared
declared actions only; no event feed is read

traps.description: A hedge ratio fitted on the whole file uses the future.
Spread flips every bar: cost eats the convergence.

controls.description: Random entries on random prices: no edge exists, so no pass level may be reached.
A causal moving-average rule on random prices: not flagged for look-ahead, and no edge claimed.

profiles.title: Carry (spot and perpetual, futures basis)
profiles.summary: Earns a yield difference such as funding or basis while holding offsetting positions.

not_assessed.why: counterparty events are not in price data
only the sample's worst bars are seen

traps.description: Position decided with the next bar's funding or price.
Entering and leaving the pair every bar pays both legs' costs each time.

controls.description: Random entries on random prices: no edge exists, so no pass level may be reached.
A causal moving-average rule on random prices: not flagged for look-ahead, and no edge claimed.

profiles.title: Cross-sectional long-short (factor, momentum, equity L/S)
profiles.summary: Ranks many instruments each period and goes long the top, short the bottom.
profiles.benchmark: Market and factor regressions; equal-weight universe

not_assessed.why: no point-in-time database is shipped: the universe must be supplied as it was
borrow history is not available; a fee and an unavailable share can be declared

traps.description: Ranking against the whole-sample mean uses the future.
Daily full re-ranking with no cost margin.

controls.description: Random entries on random prices: no edge exists, so no pass level may be reached.
A causal moving-average rule on random prices: not flagged for look-ahead, and no edge claimed.

profiles.title: Buy-and-hold / passive
profiles.summary: Holds an asset or index; the null every active strategy must beat after costs and risk.

not_assessed.why: history is one draw
not modelled

traps.description: Buying only before up days looks like a passive hold but reads tomorrow.
A 'passive' book that trades every bar is not passive.

controls.description: Never trades: nothing to verify, so no pass level may be reached.
Random entries on random prices: no edge exists, so no pass level may be reached.

profiles.title: Allocation and risk parity
profiles.summary: Fixed or risk-based weights across sleeves (60/40, inverse volatility, equal risk contribution, minimum variance).

not_assessed.what: Cost and availability of the leverage
not_assessed.why: financing terms are a declared input, not observed
regimes change sign across eras

traps.description: Weights from the covariance of the whole file use the future.
Re-weighting every bar creates turnover the allocation does not need.

controls.description: Random entries on random prices: no edge exists, so no pass level may be reached.
A causal moving-average rule on random prices: not flagged for look-ahead, and no edge claimed.

profiles.title: Market-neutral
profiles.summary: Aims at zero market exposure: long and short books of similar size, or hedged with an index.
profiles.benchmark: Zero; the market (beta must be near 0)

not_assessed.why: only the benchmark and reference asset passed in are tested
not visible in price history

traps.description: The hedge is sized with the whole sample.
Rebalancing the hedge every bar costs the whole edge.

controls.description: Random entries on random prices: no edge exists, so no pass level may be reached.
A causal moving-average rule on random prices: not flagged for look-ahead, and no edge claimed.

profiles.title: Short volatility and tail selling
profiles.summary: Collects a premium for selling insurance: small steady gains, rare large losses.

not_assessed.why: needs the margin rules of the broker
Feb 2018 and Mar 2020 style events are only tested when they are in the file

traps.description: A book that avoids the loss days by reading tomorrow looks like a smooth premium.
Constant trading is not a premium; costs eat it.

controls.description: Random entries on random prices: no edge exists, so no pass level may be reached.
A causal moving-average rule on random prices: not flagged for look-ahead, and no edge claimed.

profiles.title: Event-driven (earnings, merger arbitrage, announcements)
profiles.summary: Trades around dated events: earnings, announcements, mergers, macro releases.
profiles.benchmark: Market plus risk-free; matched non-event periods

not_assessed.why: timestamps must be publication times: only a supplied table can be joined by publication time
a short sample has few breaks

traps.description: Acting on the event period end instead of its publication time reads the future.
Trading every bar around an event window pays costs for noise.

controls.description: Random entries on random prices: no edge exists, so no pass level may be reached.
A causal moving-average rule on random prices: not flagged for look-ahead, and no edge claimed.

profiles.title: Options (long and short premium, spreads)
profiles.summary: Trades listed options: the table of trades with quotes, and when known the volatility used, the underlying price and the dates.
profiles.benchmark: Underlying and a put-write or covered-call index at matched risk
metrics_focus: P&L at the touch vs at the mid

not_assessed.what: Historical volatility surface and skew as of each date
not_assessed.why: no historical option chain is read; only the volatility the table says was used

not_assessed.what: Liquidity, open interest and tradable strikes
not_assessed.why: not in a trade table
broker rules differ; the margin is a simplified Reg-T style estimate and assignment is a warning

traps.description: Every trade fills at the mid of a wide spread: the profit disappears at the touch.
The volatility used was observed after the decision date.
Far out-of-the-money puts sold for steady small gains: a -20% move with volatility x2 wipes out the account.

controls.description: Fills at the touch, point-in-time volatility, a defined-risk spread: none of the three trap checks fails.
A table with no quotes, no volatility and no underlying: every check is reported as not assessed and the verdict is not PASS.
